owner: the Word of Mouth Dentistry team
summary: A Kogarah dental practice with a multi award claim appears to lose new patients to a leftover Covid notice and thin proof on the homepage.

findings.problem: A section called Information for Patients Regarding Covid-19 still appears on the homepage.
findings.cost: Old pandemic notices make the practice look stuck in an earlier year.
findings.fix: Replace it with a current new patient welcome.

findings.problem: Stray markup characters appear at the top of the page text.
findings.cost: Broken code looks careless on a healthcare site.

findings.problem: A Multi Award Winning claim appears with no ratings or review excerpt shown on the first page.
findings.cost: A claim with no visible proof is easy to doubt.
findings.fix: Visible ratings, review quotes and named awards.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp appears, and booking appears to rely on a Request an Appointment form and a phone number.
findings.cost: Families who want a quick reply choose another practice.
